text:
Sasha: CI on main is red — several integration tests failing with Redis connection refused to 127.0.0.1:6379 in the mock-redis step. Anyone else seeing this? https://ci.redwood/example/987

ci-bot: Job 987 failed -> redis-mock-container exited with code 137 (container killed) :warning:

Devin: I'm seeing the same on my PRs too. Re-running pipeline now.

ci-bot: Re-run queued (manual): https://ci.redwood/example/987/rerun

Maya: paste of relevant log:
```
E 03:12:45 redis_mock: connection attempt to 127.0.0.1:6379 failed: Connection refused
E 03:12:45 worker: error: backend connection lost
Container redis-mock exited with status 137
```

Chris: fwiw we bumped the redis-mock image to `redis-mock:2.4.0` in the CI pool yesterday during infra patching. Could be an image regression or an OOM. 137 normally OOM killer.

Alex: +1 on OOM theory. We also increased test parallelism in `tests/integration/ci.yml` last week (parallelism: 12). That, plus mem leak in tests, could push the runner over.

Sasha: @eng-infra can someone glance at runner node memory usage for the failing shards? If it's OOM we should either reduce parallelism or move tests to bigger runners.

oncall-bot: Alert: runner-ci-12 high memory usage at 1760405100 (see metrics dashboard)

Devin: quick bisect: pipeline passes on commit `abc123` but fails on `def456` which is exactly the test parallelism bump. Reproduced locally by running `pytest -n 12` -> fail, `pytest -n 8` -> pass.

Maya: I'll open a small PR to pin `redis-mock` back to `2.3.8` in the CI image and also reduce parallelism to 8 as a short-term mitigation. @Chris can you review when I put it up?

Chris: :thumbsup: I can review. Also let's re-run the current failing job with a smaller `PARALLELISM=8` env override to verify fix quickly.

Sasha: Re-run (override) kicked: https://ci.redwood/example/987/rerun?env=PARALLELISM=8

ci-bot: Re-run completed -> all integration shards passed ✅ (run 987-r2)

Devin: Confirmed: rerun passed on `def456` with parallelism=8. I'll add a note to the failing test to investigate potential memory usage in setup fixtures.

Maya: PR opened: #2146 pin redis-mock + reduce CI parallelism. Summary in PR description.

Sasha: Thanks everyone — rolling mitigation merged to main. We'll follow up with a deeper root-cause on the test memory growth. Closing thread once postmortem note added.

Chris: Thanks, good call on the quick mitigation. :rocket:
